description:
FIRST REGAL INTERNATIONAL AVENUE MEETING WITH TWIN CLUB CARC,CALIFORNIA.

26/07/26’ SUNDAY,7.30AM. To 8.30 AM

Agenda: A joint meeting to exchange project information about the clubs.

Attendees:
1. Rtn. Laurel Asclock
2.Rtn. Sandy Silva
3.Rtn. Paulette Cardinale
4.Rtn. Regina Vukson
5.Rtn. Jill
6.Rtn.Terri Broderick
7.Rtn.Adrienne
8.Rtn.Yvonne Zysling
9.Rtn.Cathy
10..Rtn. Dibyendu Sensharma
11.Rtn. Malabika Bose
12.Rtn. Sree Nandy
13.Rtn. Pooja Mehtaa
14.Rtn. Suparna Chakravarty
15.Rtn. Dr. Vaishali Das.

Rtn. Laurel set the tone of the meeting by welcoming all the members of RCMK AND CARC alike.
All the members introduced themselves.
Rtn. Laurel then started her presentation giving a great insight into their local and international projects.
To mention a few briefly are as follows:
Luggage of love : They collect different kinds of bags and suitcases to donate to the needy like foster children when they move from one house to another. Last year they donated 300 bags.
Walk to end Alzheimers:CARC donated $1000 to the walk in Oct 2025.
Fresno County Historical Society :They decorated the Chateau there.Rtn. Terri added that they painted around 1200 rocks and put it across the mansion. As of now the rocks are kept in a basket.
CARC sponsorsThe spirit of service scholarship in the memory of Rtn. Sally Caglia.They also sponsor some activities of their interact club.
Give Grants: Funds comes from the collection of the year before . $11000 was donated.
Tanzania dairies:
CARC works closely with the school of St Jude,Arusha ,Tanzania.
Sponsoring art and craft supplies as needed
Supply yarn and needles with which they make caps,hats, booties, etc and donate it to the orphanages.
CARC sponsors Student Beatrice since the last 7 years. She will be joining the university in this fall. She completed a year of teaching at a government school.
$1100 dollars and 50 ponds were given for art supplies.
Earlyact club:
These are kids from 6 to 13 years of age. Learning to be rotarians.
Rtn. Cathy added that they performed dance for them.
CARC has given funds to make luggage tags, it is one of the ways for them to earn some extra money. They do a lot of recycling , known as the greenventures_Tanzania on instagram.Rtn. Dibyendu added that he had picked up a lot of art and craft pieces while on his visit to Tanzania.
The kids make angels and stars for the decorations $1000 dollars have been donated for the textile crafts like table runners, quilts, etc. while they are on a break.
CARC had visited the site for blood bank setup.70 students donated blood lst week.
They received a global grant for setting up a NEONATAL ICU at St. Elizabeth’s hospital in Arusha.$60,000 dollars.
They have also given global grant to setup neonatal ICU at Venezuela along with RC of Columbia.
Peace pole project at Tephipite middle school. And quite a few more places.
CARC’s polio champion raised $66,000 dollars, members contribute too. This is highly appreciated by the district.
Interact kids participated in the walk across the golden gate bridge at San Francisco.
With an activity of family and friend spring craft day they raised 600 dollars.
Earth day(April 18th) art contest had the theme of Human influence on the earth.
Making of the blankets to be donated to the victims of human trafficking , mission being providing hope and healing.
Organised a fund raiser musical event with Artist Jeff Atamajian.
Rtn. Laurel presented the plan for the year 2026-27.

RCMK has offered to Participate and support the WALK TO END ALZHEIMER organised by CARC on the 1st of October 2026.
RTN. Ashlock mentioned about the RI meet at Minneapolis to be held from 27th May to 31st of May 2028. RCMK members to think about attending the same. Also, she mentioned about the Tanzania visit in the month of May.

The meeting concluded with vote of thanks from both the clubs on a very positive note.

Regards,
Rtn. Dr. Vaishali Das,
Club Secretary RCMK ,
International avenue director.
Rotary Club of Mumbai Kalakar.
